يستلفون (form VIII)
# يَسْتَلِفُونَ (yastalifūna) /jas.ta.li.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
# يُسْتَلَفُونَ (yustalafūna) /jus.ta.la.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَفَ (istalafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
